en.summary: This mixed commit contains several real hardware fixes, with the primary change being a two-stage TLB update path that prevents duplicate entries and supports exact-entry invalidation.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes multiple hardware bugs, led by duplicate-entry handling in the TLB.
Most of the substantive changes are in hardware TLB, ifetch, and dcache pipeline files.
The TLB rework changes real translation behavior and is suitable for portable fault reinjection.
disqualifiers: The commit is mixed: it also updates tests and the emulator.
Several independent hardware bugs are fixed together, so a second-pass entry should target one clean injection mechanism rather than claim every line is part of one bug.
evidence: hardware/core/tlb.sv is reworked into a two-stage design that reads the set first, latches request/update state, and chooses way_update_oh from either a matching way or next_way_oh.
The old TLB code comments explicitly admitted duplicate-entry handling was missing and updates simply rotated update_way without checking for an existing mapping.
Invalidate logic changes from clearing all aliases in a set to clearing the exact matching way selected after the lookup stage.
The same commit also fixes PC update gating in ifetch_tag_stage.sv and sends request_addr_nxt, not the base pointer alone, into the DTLB lookup in dcache_tag_stage.sv.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A set-associative TLB update path must first determine whether the target virtual page is already present in the indexed set. If software inserts an updated translation for a page that already exists and hardware blindly writes a rotating replacement way, the old translation can remain valid alongside the new one. That leaves duplicate translations in the same set and makes later exact invalidation unreliable.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Software inserts or refreshes a translation for a virtual page that already has a valid entry in the same TLB set.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Skip the read-before-update match search and always write the next replacement way on TLB insert/update.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: blind replacement on associative TLB insert
portability_notes: This applies to any associative TLB, CAM-backed translation cache, or similar lookup structure with software-managed insert operations.
The most portable fault target is the maintenance/update path, not the lookup datapath itself.
Exact invalidation bugs often follow from the same mechanism because stale duplicates survive after one copy is updated or invalidated.
concrete_injection_steps: In the TLB insert/update path, remove the stage that reads the indexed set to see whether the virtual page already exists.
Always choose the normal replacement victim on update, even when the incoming virtual page already matches a valid entry.
Keep lookup semantics unchanged so the failure comes from duplicate maintenance rather than ordinary translation lookup.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: two-stage TLB update and invalidate way selection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix converts the TLB update path into a read-then-update flow, uses way_update_oh to overwrite an existing matching way when present, and lets invalidation clear the exact entry instead of a whole set alias group.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Undo the read-before-update selection around way_update_oh and restore the old rotating update_way behavior that writes a new way without first checking for an existing matching translation.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Repeated TLB insert operations can leave duplicate valid translations for the same virtual page, leading to stale translations surviving updates or invalidations and causing wrong-address fetch/load behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix tlb.sv file literally states that duplicate handling was missing and updates needed to move one cycle later to read SRAM first.
The new two-stage TLB logic is the dominant hardware change in the commit and directly implements that missing read-before-update behavior.
Related fixes in ifetch and dcache show the commit is hardware-semantic, but the TLB duplicate-update path is the cleanest isolated reinjection target.
notes: This entry intentionally targets the duplicate-entry mechanism as the primary reusable injection, even though the commit also fixes other hardware bugs in ifetch and dcache.
If a broader benchmark is desired, the same commit also provides secondary injection candidates: incorrect PC advance during ITLB update and wrong DTLB lookup address on page-crossing offsets.

zh.summary: 这个混合提交包含多处真实的硬件修复，其中主导性变化是把 TLB 更新路径改成两阶段，从而避免重复表项并支持精确失效。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确描述了多个硬件缺陷，其中以 TLB 的重复表项处理为主。
绝大多数实质性修改位于硬件 TLB、ifetch 和 dcache 流水线文件中。
TLB 重构改变了真实的地址翻译行为，适合作为可移植的故障回注目标。
disqualifiers: 这是一个混合提交：同时还更新了测试和 emulator。
多个相互独立的硬件缺陷被一起修复，因此第二轮条目应选择一个干净的注入机制，而不是把所有改动都当成同一个 bug。
evidence: hardware/core/tlb.sv 被重构为两阶段设计：先读取 set、锁存请求/更新状态，再从匹配 way 或 next_way_oh 中选择 way_update_oh。
旧版 TLB 代码的注释明确承认缺少 duplicate-entry 处理，而且 update 只是轮转 update_way，并不会检查已有映射。
失效逻辑也从“清掉同一 set 中所有别名”改成了“在 lookup 之后只清掉精确匹配的 way”。
同一提交还修复了 ifetch_tag_stage.sv 中的 PC 更新 gate，以及 dcache_tag_stage.sv 中 DTLB lookup 使用 request_addr_nxt 而非仅基址的问题。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 对于组相联 TLB，更新路径必须先判断目标虚拟页是否已经存在于被索引的 set 中。如果软件为一个已经存在的页再次插入更新后的翻译，而硬件却盲目写入轮转替换 way，那么旧翻译就可能与新翻译并存并同时有效。这样同一 set 中会留下重复翻译，也会让后续的精确失效变得不可靠。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 软件为某个虚拟页插入或刷新翻译，而该页在同一个 TLB set 中已经有一个有效表项。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 跳过“更新前先读再匹配”的搜索，TLB 插入/更新时总是写入下一个替换 way。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: blind replacement on associative TLB insert
portability_notes: 可映射到任何组相联 TLB、CAM 式翻译缓存，或其他通过软件管理插入操作的相似查找结构。
最可移植的故障目标是维护/更新路径，而不是普通 lookup 数据通路。
精确失效问题通常也源于同一机制，因为一份旧副本会在另一份被更新或失效后继续残留。
concrete_injection_steps: 在 TLB 插入/更新路径中，去掉读取被索引 set 以检查该虚拟页是否已存在的阶段。
在 update 时始终选择普通替换 victim，即使输入虚拟页已经匹配某个有效表项。
保持 lookup 语义不变，使故障来自重复表项维护，而不是普通翻译查找本身。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: two-stage TLB update and invalidate way selection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 TLB update 路径改成先读后改，若已有匹配表项则通过 way_update_oh 覆盖原表项，并让失效只清掉精确命中的表项而不是整组别名。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 撤销围绕 way_update_oh 的“更新前读取并选择匹配 way”逻辑，恢复旧的轮转 update_way 行为，让更新在不检查已有匹配翻译的情况下直接写新 way。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 重复执行 TLB 插入后，同一个虚拟页可能留下多个有效翻译副本，导致更新或失效后仍残留陈旧翻译，最终表现为错误的取指或 load 地址翻译。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前的 tlb.sv 注释直接写明：duplicate handling 缺失，需要改成晚一拍先读 SRAM。
新的两阶段 TLB 逻辑是该提交中最主要的硬件变化，正是在实现这个缺失的“先读后更新”行为。
ifetch 和 dcache 的相关修复说明这是硬件语义提交，而 TLB 的 duplicate-update 路径则是其中最干净、最适合复用的注入目标。
notes: 本条目刻意把“重复表项机制”作为主要的可移植注入目标，虽然该提交同时还修复了 ifetch 和 dcache 中的其他硬件缺陷。
如果需要更宽覆盖的基准，同一提交还提供了次级注入候选：ITLB 更新期间 PC 错误前进，以及页边界偏移场景下 DTLB lookup 地址错误。
